title: Bound on the number of large stable influences
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ have variance at most $1$, and let $\delta,\varepsilon\in(0,1]$. The number of coordinates whose stable influence at parameter $1-\delta$ is at least $\varepsilon$ is at most $1/(\delta\varepsilon)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
